body_lead: The Kerala government’s decision to launch an automated system to detect traffic crimes, by deploying artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled cameras, has snowballed into a major controversy with the Congress-led Opposition alleging a lack of transparency in project allocation, and the government announcing a probe into state-owned KELTRON, which has implemented the project. The state motor vehicle department made the AI camera system operational last week as part of the Safe Kerala drive aimed at preventing road accidents and detecting traffic crimes using modern technology.
